title: Shared building blocks used by the other AquaPulse schemas

v.description: Schema version. Messages with any other value are rejected (FR-10).

timestamp.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with a Z suffix, e.g. 2026-10-30T08:15:20Z or 2026-10-30T08:15:20.123Z

deviceId.description: Device ID, also the MQTT username, e.g. home-b01-03 or tank-b01-01

seq.description: Message counter. +1 per telemetry message, back to 0 after a reboot (FR-03).

bootId.description: Random ID chosen at every boot. A new bootId tells the server the device restarted.

rssi.description: Wi-Fi signal strength in dBm (-30 is excellent, -90 is very weak)
